children: Binance said withdrawals are now restored for the Ethereum network, covering USDC, USDT and ETH, and for BNB Smart Chain, covering USDC, USDT and BNB, according to a withdrawal update on X.
The exchange said it will keep restoring additional assets and networks in phases as its security checks are completed, with further updates to be shared through official Binance channels.
Previously, Binance has already restored withdrawals for Bitcoin network.

title: Binance Restores Withdrawals for ETH and BSC Networks in Phased Rollout
